verdict.rationale: NVIDIA documents official SDKs for its GPU platform. The CUDA toolkit covers runtime and driver APIs, math libraries, compiler/PTX interfaces, and debugging and profiling tools, and NeMo, the JAX Toolbox and NIM docs add higher-level frameworks for training and deploying models. The DGX B200 software stack also ships the NVIDIA Container Toolkit. Missing for 10: explicit documentation tying these SDKs to B200/Blackwell-specific support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against them on B200.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
